description: Land Acquisition - Anuradhapura Town (FTP A2) Nuwaragampalatha D/S Division, Anuradhapura District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of eight specific land allotments in Anuradhapura District for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (S. M. Chandrasena, Minister of Lands), this is incidental to the primary purpose of the document, which is land acquisition. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals specifically with land acquisition matters, property descriptions, and land use for public purposes.
